decisions.reason: As a close-to-core support add-on that uses existing service operations and strengthens the firm's agency-focused positioning, it is cheap to keep open and still strategically valuable.

The version management tool builds directly on the firm's hosting and management stack, so despite ongoing maintenance costs its option value remains meaningful as part of the platform's differentiation.

Because the data-processing-contract tool is relatively distant from the firm's core hosting business and likely needs continued updating without clearly advancing the main platform strategy, its option value appears limited.

Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship, multi-model offer tightly aligned with the firm's stated direction, core capabilities, and a growing market, so management would strongly prefer to continue it.
